summary: GitHub CLI checks, installation, updates, and browser-based authentication.

commons.summary: GitHub CLI common helpers for CLI availability, version output, and auth status checks.

auth.summary: GitHub CLI browser authentication command implementation.

auth.run: scripts/core/init.sh [--json] gh auth [--hostname github.com] [--git-protocol https|ssh] [--scopes SCOPE_LIST] [--dry-run] [--yes]
auth.summary: Starts browser-based GitHub CLI authentication and validates the final auth status.

options.--hostname: GitHub hostname to authenticate. Defaults to github.com.
options.--git-protocol: Git protocol gh should configure: https or ssh. Defaults to https.
options.--scopes: Optional comma-separated OAuth scopes to request.
options.--dry-run: Print the browser auth command without executing it.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: GitHub CLI is missing outside dry-run.
The user does not complete browser validation.
GitHub CLI still reports unauthenticated after login.

check.summary: Checks GitHub CLI availability and authentication status.

options.--hostname: GitHub hostname to inspect. Defaults to github.com.
options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: GitHub CLI is not authenticated for the selected hostname.

install.summary: Installs GitHub CLI with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected install command path without executing it, even if GitHub CLI is already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Configures GitHub CLI's apt repository and installs gh through apt.

update.summary: Updates GitHub CLI with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected update command path without executing it, even if GitHub CLI is not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Updates gh through apt when the GitHub CLI repository is configured.

grammar: scripts/core/init.sh [--json] gh auth [--hostname github.com] [--git-protocol https|ssh] [--scopes SCOPE_LIST] [--dry-run] [--yes]

notes: check is host-read-only and does not install, update, or authenticate GitHub CLI.
auth mutates GitHub CLI credential state and requires the user to complete browser validation.
install and update mutate the host and prompt unless --yes is provided.
install, update, and auth support --dry-run where command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because GitHub CLI is already installed or currently missing.
No run command is currently defined because GitHub CLI does not expose a durable local app process for this skill.
auth.sh is the package pattern for future browser validation flows such as gcloud auth login or aws sso login.
